  • Bring strong product judgment across modern AI systems, including agents, connectors, tool use, retrieval or context, evaluations, and the tradeoffs across reliability, latency, cost, safety, and user experience.

  • Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments and can bring structure to complex work without slowing teams down.

  • Experience leading enterprise software launches involving security, identity, compliance, or deployment readiness is preferred.

  • Communicate clearly, build trust across functions, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud AI Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Product & Platform teams at OpenAI are responsible for delivering the company’s most impactful offerings—such as ChatGPT, our API platform, and new enterprise capabilities—to a global and diverse customer base. These systems must perform at scale and deliver exceptional experiences to developers, consumers, and businesses alike.

Technical Program Managers at OpenAI play a key leadership role in scaling these efforts, partnering deeply with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to bring ambitious ideas to life and ensure clarity and discipline in execution.

About the Role

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to support OpenAI's critical AI deployments across strategic cloud partners. This role is designed for a candidate who can operate as an end-to-end owner across internal engineering teams and external partner organizations.

This role will drive the technical strategy and execution required to bring OpenAI models and platform capabilities into partner environments responsibly and at scale. The work spans engineering deliverables, shared roadmaps, model launch pipelines, technical integration, launch readiness, and post-launch follow-through.

You will work closely with senior leaders across OpenAI engineering, infrastructure, product, safety, security, legal, finance, and go-to-market, as well as technical counterparts at our partners. The job is to turn broad partnership commitments into concrete execution plans, align both sides on what must land, and build repeatable mechanisms for launching OpenAI capabilities on third-party platforms.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end execution for major cloud partner programs spanning model deployment, product integration, operational readiness, launch follow-through, and partner-platform adoption.

  • Own integrated technical roadmaps across OpenAI and partner teams, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing needs, and the sequencing required to land joint commitments.

  • Own launch readiness across cloud partner platforms, including readiness checklists, blocker tracking, joint go/no-go reviews, and post-launch stability follow-through.

  • Act as a primary technical interface to partner engineering organizations, helping own the shared roadmap and day-to-day coordination on deployment, capacity, incidents, and open engineering issues.

  • Drive alignment across engineering, infrastructure, product, safety, security, legal, finance, and go-to-market teams so joint deliverables are well-scoped, sequenced, and executable.

  • Provide clear, transparent reporting on program status, issues, risks, and decisions required for senior leaders and stakeholders.

  • Convert open issues into prioritized plans that both OpenAI and partner teams can commit to, with clear owners, workbacks, and closure paths.

  • Help build repeatable and efficient development and launch pipelines for OpenAI models on partner platforms.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring substantial technical program management leadership across infrastructure, platform, or large-scale engineering work, with a track record of owning complex programs end to end.

  • Have led complex partner-facing programs where success required tight coordination across company boundaries, clear operating rhythms, and sustained follow-through.

  • Understand cloud architectures, AI/ML deployment, model serving, and the practical integration challenges of bringing advanced AI systems to production.

  • Direct experience with major cloud or AI platforms, including how models are integrated, launched, and onboarded for customers.

  • Familiarity with how foundation models are integrated, packaged, launched, and operated through partner platforms or marketplaces.

  • Experience with inference systems, model serving, accelerator-backed infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Can balance strategic priorities with rapid, high-quality execution in fast-moving environments.

  • Communicate crisply with engineers, executives, and external partners, and can create alignment without direct authority.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, scaling environments and can bring order to complex cross-functional work without losing pace.

  • Exercise strong judgment on risk, sequencing, and the difference between a target date and a credible launch plan.

  • Care about OpenAI's mission and about expanding responsible access to advanced AI systems.

title: Software Engineer, Financial Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Applied team at OpenAI safely brings cutting-edge technology to the world. We have released groundbreaking products such as ChatGPT, Plugins, DALL·E, and APIs for GPT-4, GPT-3, embeddings, and fine-tuning. Our team also manages large-scale inference infrastructure. With much more on the horizon, our impact continues to grow.

Our customers create fast-growing businesses using our APIs, enabling product features previously unimaginable. ChatGPT exemplifies the current scope of possibilities. We prioritize the responsible use of our powerful tools, valuing safe deployment over unchecked expansion.

Within Applied Engineering, the Financial Engineering team ensures that our products are monetized effectively to accommodate customers' varying needs and scales. Collaborating closely with the GTM and Finance teams, we strive to tailor our billing stack to our evolving internal requirements. We seek an experienced engineer to architect and refine our billing systems, enhancing their functionality to meet the demands of our increasingly complex and expansive product offerings.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and build the next generation of billing and monetization systems at OpenAI.

  • Develop across the stack to create comprehensive billing integrations for our range of ChatGPT and API users.

  • Design a versatile billing platform suitable for both subscription and usage-based offerings, ensuring scalability and enterprise readiness/flexibility.

  • Construct and integrate tools that empower internal teams to seamlessly incorporate billing data into their workflows.

  • Collaborate closely with a wide array of stakeholders, including the Product, Data, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams, as well as fellow engineers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess a minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with added experience in payments, billing, or monetization seen as a bonus.

  • Enjoy engaging with various partners, particularly those outside of engineering.

  • Have a keen and innate desire to learn and acquire new skills, coupled with a strong ability to impart that knowledge clearly and succinctly to others.

  • Bring significant experience in developing (and redeveloping) production systems to launch new product capabilities and to handle scaling challenges.

  • Are deeply invested in creating an exceptional user experience, taking pride in crafting products that address customer needs.

  • Ability to move fast in an environment where things are sometimes loosely defined and may have competing priorities or deadlines.

We have released groundbreaking products such as ChatGPT, Plugins, DALL·E, and APIs for GPT-4, GPT-3, embeddings, and fine-tuning. Our team also manages large-scale inference infrastructure. With much more on the horizon, our impact continues to grow.

Our customers create fast-growing businesses using our APIs, enabling product features previously unimaginable. ChatGPT exemplifies the current scope of possibilities. We prioritize the responsible use of our powerful tools, valuing safe deployment over unchecked expansion.

Within Applied Engineering, the Financial Engineering team ensures that our products are monetized effectively to accommodate customers' varying needs and scales. Collaborating closely with the GTM and Finance teams, we strive to tailor our billing stack to our evolving internal requirements. We seek an experienced engineer to architect and refine our billing systems, enhancing their functionality to meet the demands of our increasingly complex and expansive product offerings.

In this role, you will:

 - Architect and build the next generation of billing and monetization systems at OpenAI.

 - Develop across the stack to create comprehensive billing integrations for our range of ChatGPT and API users.

 - Design a versatile billing platform suitable for both subscription and usage-based offerings, ensuring scalability and enterprise readiness/flexibility.

 - Construct and integrate tools that empower internal teams to seamlessly incorporate billing data into their workflows.

 - Collaborate closely with a wide array of stakeholders, including the Product, Data, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams, as well as fellow engineers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Possess a minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience, with added experience in payments, billing, or monetization seen as a bonus.

 - Enjoy engaging with various partners, particularly those outside of engineering.

 - Have a keen and innate desire to learn and acquire new skills, coupled with a strong ability to impart that knowledge clearly and succinctly to others.

 - Bring significant experience in developing (and redeveloping) production systems to launch new product capabilities and to handle scaling challenges.

 - Are deeply invested in creating an exceptional user experience, taking pride in crafting products that address customer needs.

 - Ability to move fast in an environment where things are sometimes loosely defined and may have competing priorities or deadlines.

title: Manager, Partner Applied AI Engineering (AWS)
descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Applied AI Engineering (AAE) team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises turn the potential of generative AI into real-world impact. We act as trusted advisors and technical partners to customers and ecosystem partners, helping identify high-impact AI use cases and bring them into production through strong architectural guidance and hands-on execution.

The Partner Applied AI Engineering organization works closely with strategic cloud providers, systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners to scale successful adoption of OpenAI technologies. As the leader of the AWS Partner AAE pod, you will manage a team of Applied AI Engineers focused on enabling AWS-aligned partners and their customers to build, deploy, and operationalize AI applications on OpenAI’s platform.

About the role

We are seeking a Manager, Partner Applied AI Engineering – AWS to lead a team of Applied AI Engineers supporting strategic AWS ecosystem partnerships. In this role, you will own the technical success strategy for AWS-aligned partners and help build scalable, repeatable ways for partners and their customers to adopt OpenAI technologies.

Your team will guide partners and customers across the full AI implementation lifecycle—from identifying and shaping high-value use cases to solution design, architecture, production deployment, optimization, and adoption growth. You will work cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders across Sales, Partnerships, Product, Research, and Engineering to ensure the voice of partners and customers informs our platform roadmap and how we bring OpenAI technology into production at scale.

This role requires a blend of technical depth, customer leadership, operational rigor, and people management. Success will be measured through production deployments, partner technical maturity, API adoption growth, team development, and the overall impact of the AWS partner ecosystem.

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Applied AI Engineers supporting strategic AWS partner engagements and customer deployments.

  • Define the operating model, engagement strategy, and technical priorities for the AWS Partner AAE pod.

  • Partner closely with AWS partner leadership, solution architects, delivery organizations, and customer stakeholders to identify high-impact AI opportunities and accelerate production adoption of OpenAI technologies.

  • Guide teams through complex generative AI and traditional ML implementations, including use case shaping, architecture reviews, implementation planning, security considerations, evaluation strategies, and operational readiness.

  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for critical partner and customer engagements, helping teams navigate ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Product, Research, and Engineering teams to synthesize partner and customer feedback into platform improvements, tooling enhancements, and applied AI best practices.

  • Develop scalable enablement frameworks, reference architectures, and repeatable implementation patterns that improve partner effectiveness and reduce time-to-production.

  • Drive operational excellence across the team, including resource planning, prioritization, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.

  • Act as an external thought leader on applied AI, cloud-native AI architectures, and responsible AI adoption within the AWS ecosystem.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles, including managing executive-level technical and business relationships with enterprise organizations and strategic partners.

  • Have 3+ years of experience leading high-performing technical teams in applied AI engineering, solutions engineering, deployment engineering, forward-deployed engineering, customer engineering, or post-sales environments.

  • Have hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI and traditional ML systems in production environments, including familiarity with LLM application architectures, evaluation methodologies, orchestration frameworks, and operational best practices.

  • Have strong knowledge of AWS cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native architectures, including networking, security, compute, storage, observability, and application deployment patterns.

  • Have experience working with cloud ecosystem partners, systems integrators, consultancies, or technical alliance organizations.

  • Have technical depth in software engineering or solution development using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

  • Are comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical engagement and operational execution.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executives, partners, developers, and customers alike.

  • Have a strong sense of ownership, humility, and curiosity, with a willingness to learn quickly and help others succeed in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Inventory and Cost Accounting Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Controllership team delivers the financial truth that powers OpenAI’s growth. By translating operational activity into accurate, timely, and decision-grade financial data, we enable leadership to scale the business with confidence. Our commitment to rigorous controls and best-in-class systems ensures financial integrity as OpenAI grows.

 

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Inventory & Cost Accounting Lead to build and scale manufacturing accounting and product costing capabilities across consumer hardware and robotics businesses. This role partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Technical Accounting, Strategic Finance, and Systems teams to establish scalable costing methodologies, inventory valuation processes, manufacturing close procedures, and reporting infrastructure supporting rapid growth and product launches.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in consumer hardware manufacturing environments, including standard costing, inventory accounting, variance analysis, contract manufacturing, and ERP operationalization — particularly within Oracle Fusion. This person should thrive in ambiguity, balance strategic thinking with operational execution, and possess the executive presence and judgment to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 

In this role, you will:

Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting

  • Lead product costing and inventory accounting across consumer hardware and robotics programs, including inventory valuation, manufacturing variances, reserves, and close processes.

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Strategic Finance to support BOM accuracy, labor and overhead assumptions, and gross margin analysis.

  • Develop scalable accounting processes for NPI, prototyping, engineering builds, and mass production.

  • Own inventory-related accounting policies and controls, including capitalization, overhead allocation, LCNRV/NRV assessments, rebates, freight, tariffs, and inventory controls.

ERP Systems & Process Design

  • Serve as a finance lead for Oracle Fusion manufacturing costing and inventory implementations, enhancements, and process optimization.

  • Partner with Systems, IT, and Operations to design scalable finance processes, controls, reporting structures, and operational workflows.

  • Drive ERP configuration decisions related to standard costing, inventory subledger processes, manufacturing transactions, and cost books.

Financial Close, Reporting & Controls

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting close activities and improve scalable reconciliations, reporting, and management review processes.

  • Partner with Strategic Finance on margin reporting, inventory analytics, and budget versus actual analysis.

  • Establish SOX-ready controls, support audits and technical accounting matters, and drive continuous improvement across close and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Program Management teams.

  • Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks.

  • Influence senior stakeholders through strong communication, executive presence, and data-driven recommendations.

  • Help build and scale the long-term roadmap for hardware controllership, manufacturing accounting, and operational finance infrastructure.

 

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Have deep expertise in manufacturing accounting and cost accounting within consumer hardware or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

  • Can comfortably operate between strategic leadership discussions and highly detailed operational accounting analyses.

  • Have strong executive presence and can communicate effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Enjoy building scalable processes and infrastructure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

  • Are highly detail-oriented and maintain a strong control mindset while balancing business partnership.

  • Have a strong systems orientation and enjoy designing scalable ERP and reporting processes.

  • Are intellectually curious, proactive, and solutions-oriented.

 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in manufacturing accounting, cost accounting, or inventory accounting.

  • Significant experience within consumer hardware, electronics, robotics, semiconductor, or complex manufacturing industries.

  • Deep expertise in standard costing, inventory valuation, manufacturing variances, overhead absorption, and inventory close processes.

  • Strong experience working with contract manufacturers and global supply chain environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion ERP, particularly Costing and Inventory modules.

  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP related to inventory and manufacturing accounting.

  • Experience building scalable accounting processes, controls, and reporting infrastructure.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA and/or public accounting background.

  • Experience supporting hardware product launches and rapid manufacturing scale-up.

  • Experience designing or implementing ERP systems and finance process transformations.

  • Experience in a high-growth technology or pre-IPO/public company environment.

  • Experience building or leading teams in complex operational accounting environments.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, and procurement workflows.

 

Why This Role Matters

This role will play a foundational part in building the accounting infrastructure that supports the next generation of AI hardware products. You will help shape the systems, policies, controls, and operational processes that enable scalable manufacturing operations, reliable financial reporting, and launch readiness as the business rapidly grows.

You’ll have the opportunity to work cross-functionally with world-class teams at the forefront of AI, robotics, and consumer hardware innovation while helping build a best-in-class hardware controllership organization from the ground up.

title: Software Engineer, Payments
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Payments Team is working to make AGI financially sustainable by enabling OpenAI to accept payments across our existing products (ChatGPT, ChatGPT for Teams, API) and supporting future commercial experiences. We own the user-facing payments experience, direct integrations with payment service providers, and other supporting infrastructure that powers checkout and payment flows. Payments works closely with teams across Finance, Legal, Growth, Product, external vendors and more to ensure our payments infrastructure scales with the business and supports evolving commercial goals.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Payments Team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s financial systems. title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives)
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team partners closely with customers to help them turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across strategy, solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.

The Digital Natives segment serves technology and software companies that are building AI into the core of their products and businesses. These customers are often highly technical, move quickly, and are among the earliest adopters of OpenAI’s newest capabilities. Our Applied AI Engineers work directly with their engineering, product, and technical leadership teams to identify high-impact opportunities, solve complex technical challenges, and bring ambitious AI applications into production.


About the Role

We are seeking a Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives) to lead the team responsible for the technical success of our most strategic technology and software customers in the Americas.

In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers who work hands-on with customers to design, build, evaluate, and scale AI applications. You will help determine where deep technical partnership can unlock the greatest customer and business impact, while developing repeatable approaches that allow the team to support a broad and fast-moving customer segment.

As a manager, you will set the strategy and operating model for the team, coach and develop engineers, and serve as a senior technical partner to customers and internal stakeholders. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Research to connect what we learn from customers with OpenAI’s product direction and help customers take advantage of our newest capabilities.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful production applications, sustained adoption and usage, strong customer outcomes, and technical patterns and insights that can be applied across the broader Digital Natives segment.

This role is open in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In This Role, You Will

  • Own the strategy and operating model for the Digital Natives Applied AI Engineering team, ensuring alignment with OpenAI’s objectives and the evolving needs of technology and software customers.

  • Lead, hire, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing Applied AI Engineers responsible for delivering meaningful technical and customer outcomes.

  • Guide the team in working hands-on with customers to identify high-impact use cases, design and build AI applications, solve technical challenges, and scale successful solutions into production.

  • Partner closely with Sales to prioritize technical engagement across strategic customers and identify where Applied AI Engineering can unlock adoption, usage, and long-term customer growth.

  • Serve as a senior technical partner and escalation point for priority customers, building trusted relationships with engineering leaders, CTOs, and other executive stakeholders.

  • Represent the technical voice of Digital Native customers by synthesizing insights around model performance, developer experience, product gaps, emerging use cases, and technical blockers for Product, Engineering, and Research.

  • Translate recurring customer needs and successful implementations into repeatable technical patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, tooling, and best practices that allow the team to scale its impact.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership.

  • Help customers understand and apply OpenAI’s newest capabilities, identifying opportunities to build differentiated products and experiences with frontier models.

  • Champion the safe, reliable, and effective application of OpenAI’s technology across the Digital Natives ecosystem.


You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, with a demonstrated ability to hire, develop, mentor, and manage high-performing engineers.

  • Have experience building or deploying generative AI, machine learning, developer platforms, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

  • Bring strong technical depth across APIs, AI/ML systems, application architecture, cloud infrastructure, and modern developer workflows.

  • Have hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Are comfortable working directly with highly technical engineering and product teams as well as CTOs and other executive stakeholders.

  • Can translate ambiguous customer and business problems into clear technical approaches and guide teams from exploration through implementation and production.

  • Demonstrate strong judgment about when to invest deeply in an individual customer challenge versus when to develop a repeatable solution for the broader segment.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics across audiences and coach others to do the same.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and are energized by working with customers at the forefront of AI adoption.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, curiosity, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack, Revenue Platform
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Revenue Platform sits at the intersection of customer experience, financial precision, and enterprise-grade reliability. We build both end-user experiences and the underlying platform capabilities that power invoicing, billing, payments, and revenue recognition across OpenAI. Our work spans high-leverage customer surfaces and deep, reusable platform primitives used by multiple teams. These are foundational systems that will support OpenAI’s growth for years to come, and we’re looking for engineers who care deeply about craftsmanship, correctness, and building platforms and experiences that scale gracefully and are a joy to build on.

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Achieving that mission requires more than great models, it demands a world-class commercial platform that enterprises can trust. The Revenue Platform team enables organizations to confidently adopt, scale, and manage their usage of OpenAI products by providing reliable, extensible financial infrastructure and shared services that power the broader ecosystem.

We’re looking for a full-stack engineer to take end-to-end ownership of critical revenue workflows and the platform abstractions behind them. You’ll work across APIs, data models, shared services, and user interfaces to solve hard problems in scale, correctness, and usability. Partnering closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Operations, and other engineering teams, you’ll turn complex business requirements into durable platform capabilities, raising the bar on engineering quality and developer experience as our products and enterprise footprint grow.


About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Revenue Platform team, you will design, build, and operate platform services and user-facing interfaces that form the backbone of OpenAI’s commercial engine. You’ll collaborate with product, design, finance, and engineering partners to deliver intuitive customer experiences while also creating shared foundations that other teams can safely and efficiently build on. Your work will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and trustworthiness of OpenAI’s most critical financial workflows.


In this role, you will:

  • Build and evolve shared full-stack platform components including APIs, data models, services, and UI primitives that power billing, subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and enterprise entitlements across OpenAI.

  • Design scalable, reusable revenue workflows and abstractions that other product teams can compose to launch new offerings without reinventing core billing logic.

  • Partner closely with product, frontend, and backend engineers to deliver end-to-end revenue capabilities, ensuring platform components are intuitive to adopt and safe to extend.

  • Develop internal platforms and tools used by Finance, Accounting, Sales, Support, and Go-To-Market teams to manage, audit, and reason about revenue data efficiently.

  • Build automation and AI-powered capabilities within the Revenue Platform to reduce manual work, surface insights, and improve operational decision-making.

  • Help define the architecture, standards, and contracts for a shared revenue platform, balancing flexibility for product teams with correctness, reliability, and compliance.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to translate ambiguous commercial, financial, and operational requirements into durable platform primitives that scale with OpenAI’s products and customer base.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • 5+ years of experience building full-stack web applications with strong fundamentals across frontend, backend, and API design.

  • Proficiency with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript) and backend technologies (Python preferred; Node, Go, or similar also welcome).

  • Experience designing or working with scalable backend systems, data models, and event-driven or workflow architectures.

  • Strong product instincts and passion for building intuitive, high-reliability user experiences.

  • Experience working in environments where correctness, traceability, and data integrity matter—e.g., billing, payments, finance, enterprise SaaS, or similar domains (preferred, not required).

  • Comfort owning features end-to-end across UI, APIs, data, and operations.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements and priorities.

title: Frontend Engineer, Financial Web Platform
descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Applied team at OpenAI safely brings cutting-edge technology to the world. We have released widely used products such as ChatGPT, Sora, and the OpenAI API, powering models including GPT-5 and a growing set of multimodal capabilities across text, image, audio, and video. Our team also manages large-scale inference and platform infrastructure that supports these experiences at global scale. With much more on the horizon, our impact continues to grow.

Our customers build fast-growing businesses using our APIs, unlocking product capabilities that were previously unimaginable. ChatGPT and Sora exemplify the breadth of what’s now possible across text, image, audio, and video experiences. As these capabilities expand, we prioritize the responsible use of our technology, emphasizing safe and thoughtful deployment over unchecked growth.

Within Applied Engineering, the Financial Engineering team builds the frontend platforms and workflows that power how OpenAI’s products are priced, purchased, and managed at scale. We work closely with Go-To-Market and Finance partners to translate complex commercial requirements into clear, reusable billing experiences. We’re looking for a frontend engineer to help define and evolve these billing platforms, shaping the primitives, interfaces, and patterns that product teams rely on as our offerings and customer needs continue to grow in complexity.

In this role, you will:

  • Create scalable, reusable UI components and patterns that support a wide range of billing use cases across products.

  • Partner closely with backend engineers to deliver end-to-end billing capabilities spanning subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and enterprise offerings.

  • Build tools and surfaces that allow teams like Finance, Sales, Support, and GTM to manage and reason about billing data efficiently.

  • Create AI powered features for billing workflows and platform tooling to automate repetitive tasks, surface insights, and improve decision-making.

  • Help define frontend architecture, standards, and patterns for a shared billing platform used by teams across OpenAI.

  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Finance, Go-To-Market, and Engineering partners to translate ambiguous requirements into clear, high-quality interfaces.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Software engineering experience, with added experience in payments, billing, or monetization seen as a bonus.

  • Strong frontend engineering experience building and maintaining production-grade web applications, with an emphasis on usability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Enjoy engaging with various partners, particularly those outside of engineering.

  • Have a keen and innate desire to learn and acquire new skills, coupled with a strong ability to impart that knowledge clearly and succinctly to others.

  • Bring significant experience in developing (and redeveloping) production systems to launch new product capabilities and to handle scaling challenges.

  • Are deeply invested in creating an exceptional user experience, taking pride in crafting products that address customer needs.

  • Ability to move fast in an environment where things are sometimes loosely defined and may have competing priorities or deadlines.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Head of Growth GSIs - Cognizant Infosys & Wipro
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission toward AGI. We work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and GTM to deliver strong partner outcomes through disciplined strategy and execution.

This role sits within Partnerships/GTM and will lead OpenAI’s strategy and execution with Global Systems Integrators such as Cognizant, Infosys and Wipro. These partnerships are critical to helping enterprise customers adopt, implement, and scale OpenAI’s products through trusted advisory, transformation, and delivery channels.

This role will be hybrid based in our San Francisco office.

About the Role

We are hiring a Head of Growth GSIs - Cognizant Infosys & Wipro to lead and scale OpenAI’s partnerships with Global Systems Integrators. You will be responsible for building strategic relationships with leading GSI partners, translating shared priorities into scalable partnership motions, and driving customer adoption through joint go-to-market, solution development, and delivery enablement.

This leader will operate as the single accountable owner for a portfolio of high-impact GSI partnerships, setting direction, establishing operating cadence, and aligning internal and partner stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires strong executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex, global, cross-functional partnerships across GTM, product, solutions, legal, security, and partner organizations.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and grow OpenAI’s strategic partnerships with International GSIs, with accountability for partnership health, adoption, revenue impact, and long-term growth.

  • Define the partnership strategy and priorities for GSIs, including joint business plans, goals, execution roadmaps, and success metrics.

  • Establish and run a durable operating model, including governance, executive alignment, escalation paths, business reviews, and execution cadence.

  • Build and drive joint GTM plans with Sales, Solutions, and Marketing teams, including field enablement, solution positioning, demand generation, and coordinated customer execution.

  • Partner with Solutions, Product, and Engineering teams to identify repeatable enterprise use cases, delivery motions, and implementation patterns that help customers successfully adopt OpenAI products at scale.

  • Collaborate with Security, Legal, Privacy, and Commercial teams to ensure appropriate trust, compliance, and commercial frameworks for partner-led work.

  • Enable GSI partners to build OpenAI expertise across advisory, implementation, transformation, and managed services practices.

  • Track performance against clear metrics, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement across partnerships, programs, and field execution.

  • Represent OpenAI with senior partner executives, driving alignment, resolving issues, and expanding partnership scope over time.

  • Travel regularly to international locations such as India

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience leading strategic GSI, alliances, or channel partnerships in enterprise software, cloud, consulting, or AI.

  • Deep familiarity with Global Systems Integrators and how they operate across global enterprise customers, transformation programs, and delivery organizations.

  • A track record building and scaling partnerships from early-stage strategy through executive alignment, field activation, delivery enablement, and measurable business impact.

  • Strong technical and product fluency, with the ability to partner effectively with Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Security teams without needing to be the hands-on implementer.

  • Experience navigating enterprise requirements related to security, privacy, governance, compliance, and commercial models in partner-led initiatives.

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and the ability to drive alignment across Sales/GTM, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Legal, and partner organizations.

  • Strong executive presence, negotiation capability, and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

  • Clear, concise communication skills with experience producing decision-ready memos, joint plans, executive updates, and partnership business reviews.

title: Revenue Accounting Manager, Ads
descriptionHtml:
About the Team
OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows.

About the Role

This role will own accounting and controllership for OpenAI's advertising products. You will help build the financial foundation for Ads from early scale into durable operations, including revenue recognition, close, controls, reporting, reconciliations, and risk assessment across measurement logic, billing data, rev-share structures, incentives, credits, and emerging monetization models.

You will be a finance partner to Product, Engineering, Technical Accounting, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Financial Systems. The role requires someone who can independently operate in ambiguity, design 0-to-1 processes and apply AI automation thoughtfully to support a rapidly evolving product environment.

Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Own end-to-end accounting and controllership for Ads revenue, including revenue recognition, contra-revenue, rev-share, incentives, credits, rebates, and related close activities under ASC 606.

  • Design and execute scalable month-end and quarter-end close processes for Ads, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely reporting supported by reconciliations, flux analysis, and reviewer-ready evidence.

  • Design accounting and control frameworks for global Ads expansion, including new currencies, billing entities, tax/invoice localization, FX, AR, and GL mapping.

  • Translate complex commercial, product, and contractual terms into operational accounting workflows with clear policy alignment and scalable execution.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance Engineering, Data, and Billing teams to define, validate, and audit Ads measurement logic such as impressions, clicks, billable events, usage, rev-share, and invoice data.

  • Identify material risks, separate systemic issues from immaterial noise, and communicate substantiated recommendations to Finance and business leaders.

  • Use AI, data tooling, and automation to improve close speed, exception management, reconciliation quality, and control execution while preserving appropriate governance.

  • Support system implementations and enhancements across Oracle Fusion, data warehouses, billing integrations, ads platforms, and related finance tooling.

  • Lead audit support, documentation, walkthroughs, issue resolution, and remediation for Ads revenue accounting.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including ads revenue accounting or controllership in a public company or high-growth late stage private company.

  • CPA or equivalent expertise, with strong command of ASC 606 and practical judgment on variable consideration, principal-agent, incentives, credits, and revenue-share arrangements.

  • Non-negotiable advertising business expertise: direct experience with ads, adtech, retail media, marketplace monetization, or a closely analogous high-volume usage-based revenue model. Preference for candidates with direct experience with advertiser/customer incentive arrangements, multi-currency billing, global invoicing/localization, or multi-entity revenue accounting.

  • Proven ability to build 0-to-1 finance processes, then harden them into scalable close procedures, reconciliations, controls, and audit-ready evidence.

  • Strong data fluency, including comfort validating high-volume calculations, tracing source-system data to billing and GL outputs, and partnering with data or engineering teams.

  • Practical experience applying AI, analytics, or automation in a Finance org, with clear judgment about controls, review points, and limits of automation.

  • Balanced materiality and risk judgment: able to quantify impact, identify root cause, assess control implications, and recommend proportionate action backed by evidence.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion ERP, revenue systems, billing platforms, or finance transformation work.

  • Passion for technology, AI, and building financial infrastructure that lets new products scale responsibly.

Workplace & Location

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

title: Partner Director, HCL, Wipro & Cognizant
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI's GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI's mission toward AGI. We work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to turn strategic partnerships into measurable business outcomes.

This role sits within the GTM Partnerships organization and is responsible for leading OpenAI's strategic relationships with three of the world's largest Global Systems Integrators (GSIs): HCLTech, Wipro, and Cognizant. These partners play a critical role in helping enterprise customers design, deploy, and scale AI solutions by combining OpenAI's technology with deep industry expertise, consulting capabilities, and global delivery organizations.

This role reports to the Head of GSIs and will be responsible for driving executive alignment, joint go-to-market strategy, commercial execution, and scalable partnership programs across these strategic accounts.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partner Director, HCL, Wipro & Cognizant to lead and grow three of OpenAI's most strategic Global Systems Integrator partnerships. You will own executive relationships, develop and execute joint business plans, and drive coordinated go-to-market motions that accelerate customer adoption and revenue growth.

This is a highly strategic, externally facing role that requires a blend of executive relationship management, commercial leadership, operational excellence, and ecosystem expertise. You'll work closely with OpenAI Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Legal, Security, and partner leadership teams to build repeatable motions that generate pipeline, enable successful customer deployments, and deepen long-term strategic alignment.

The ideal candidate understands how large consulting organizations operate, has experience driving revenue through strategic partnerships, and thrives in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments where they can build new programs while scaling existing ones.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the strategic and commercial relationships with HCLTech, Wipro, and Cognizant, driving long-term partnership growth and executive alignment.

  • Develop and execute joint business plans that accelerate customer acquisition, AI adoption, and revenue across enterprise accounts.

  • Build scalable co-sell motions with OpenAI Sales teams, including joint account planning, pipeline generation, executive engagement, and opportunity management.

  • Partner closely with alliance leaders, AI practice teams, industry leaders, and delivery organizations within each GSI to develop repeatable AI transformation offerings.

  • Drive field collaboration between OpenAI Account Executives and partner sellers to increase pipeline creation, customer wins, and successful deployments.

  • Establish strong operating cadence across internal and partner stakeholders through quarterly business reviews, executive governance, pipeline inspections, forecasting, and performance reporting.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Security, Legal, and Commercial teams to support partner-led customer engagements and remove blockers to execution.

  • Help partners build differentiated OpenAI capabilities through enablement programs, certifications, solution development, and AI practice expansion.

  • Identify new market opportunities, industry solutions, and regional growth initiatives that strengthen OpenAI's position within each partner organization.

  • Represent OpenAI alongside executive partner leadership in customer meetings, strategic planning sessions, conferences, and industry events.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have

  • Significant experience leading strategic alliances, Global Systems Integrator partnerships, or ecosystem relationships within enterprise software, cloud, AI, or consulting.

  • Deep familiarity with large GSIs—particularly HCLTech, Wipro, and Cognizant—and an understanding of how they operate across consulting, systems integration, managed services, and enterprise transformation.

  • Experience building and executing joint go-to-market strategies that produce measurable pipeline, customer adoption, and revenue growth.

  • A strong track record of influencing enterprise sales organizations and driving successful co-sell execution across complex buying cycles.

  • Experience developing executive relationships across both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong operational rigor with experience managing governance frameworks, business reviews, forecasting, pipeline health, and executive communications.

  • Technical fluency and the ability to engage credibly with solution architects, AI practice leaders, delivery organizations, and engineering stakeholders without being hands-on technical.

  • Experience supporting enterprise AI, cloud, SaaS, or digital transformation initiatives for large global customers.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.

  • A builder mindset with the ability to create scalable partnership programs, solve ambiguous problems, and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment while balancing strategic thinking with operational excellence.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
